en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Baroque pilgrimage church complex with two tall onion-domed towers and a central dome, surrounded by smaller buildings and trees. In the foreground there is a cemetery with numerous crosses. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Maria Trost bei Graz." Additional small vertical print appears along the left margin, and a number is printed near the lower left.
